answer:
The monthly limit in your Household expenses app is now set to 12 000 kr, and you can change it yourself. Open the note's App side, go to More › App Settings and edit "Monthly limit (kr)". The app updates straight away.

I also fixed three other things while I was in there:
- **Amount column:** The app didn't recognise your "Amt" column, so the limit and totals wouldn't have shown. It reads that column now.
- **Labels:** The input fields on the add-expense form now have labels.
- **"Add" button:** Its text is darker so it's easier to read.

The app's check now comes back clean.

The totals still add up every row in the note, not just the current month. Say so if you want them limited to the current month.
